_doc: Maps sequence-archetype scene roles to storyboard content_types. Used by compose_storyboard to select a panel template per beat. Content types follow docs/cinematography/specs/storyboard-format.md (typography, insight_cards, prompt_input, chart_panel, dashboard, logo_lockup, device_mockup, split_panel, stat_callout).

act_rules._doc: How to derive panel.act from scene position and energy curve.

content_type_defaults._doc: Default visual_direction strings used when brand notes are absent. The LLM enrichment layer rewrites these into specific px/weight/color values.

typography.composition: Centered text, generous negative space on all sides. Single line or short stacked lines.
typography.typography: Display sans, light weight (300-400). Generous line height.
typography.color: High-contrast text on the personality's primary background.
typography.surfaces: No surface — text on background only.
typography.reference: Mercury 'Clarity takes craft.' frame — restraint as design.

insight_cards.composition: Cards centered, ~560px max width, 14px gap, vertically centered as a group.
insight_cards.typography: Card titles: 15px weight 600. Detail text: 13px weight 400 at 55% opacity.
insight_cards.color: Card background: 3.5% white on dark. Border: 6% white. Accent colors per content semantics.
insight_cards.reference: Mercury insight cards — equal visual weight, stacked simply.

prompt_input.composition: Input field centered horizontally and vertically. ~580px max width. Nothing else on screen.
prompt_input.typography: 15px weight 400 inside the input. Reads like a real user typing, not a label.
prompt_input.color: Input bg: 5% white. Border: 8% white. Submit button: brand accent. Upload icon: 30% white.
prompt_input.reference: Mercury prompt input — one input, one action, nothing else.

chart_panel.composition: Elevated panel centered, ~580px max width. Header → explanation → chart → optional input. 28px padding, 24px between sections.
chart_panel.typography: Panel title: 17px weight 600. Explanation: 13px weight 400 at 50% opacity. Labels: 11px at 50% opacity.
chart_panel.color: Panel bg: elevated surface (one tier above page). Bars: 15% white. Axis: 6% white.
chart_panel.surfaces: Panel: 18px border radius. Bars: 4px top radius. Deep shadow (32px blur, 50% black).
chart_panel.reference: Mercury drilldown panel — simple bars, no gridlines, the data speaks.

dashboard.composition: Full-width dashboard. Sidebar 200px (darker than main bg). Main area with 24px/32px padding. Charts right, text left.
dashboard.typography: Nav: 12px. Page title: 22px weight 600. Tab labels: 12px. Stat values: 26px weight 600 (primary), 17px weight 500 (secondary).
dashboard.color: Sidebar deeper than main. Active nav: 6% white bg, full opacity text. Chart bars: brand accent + slate.
dashboard.surfaces: Sidebar border-right: 6% white. Tab active: 7% white bg, 7px radius. Chart bars: 2px radius.
dashboard.reference: Mercury full dashboard — a real product, not a wireframe. Every pixel earns space.

logo_lockup.composition: Logo + wordmark centered, slightly above vertical center. Disclaimer below at small size, low opacity. 48px gap between groups.
logo_lockup.typography: Wordmark: 24px weight 400, 0.15em letter-spacing. Disclaimer: 11px at 25% opacity, max-width 600px, centered.
logo_lockup.color: Wordmark: warm off-white. Disclaimer: barely visible.
logo_lockup.surfaces: No surface. Logo mark may have subtle accent border.
logo_lockup.reference: Mercury logo lockup — quietly there with legal below.

device_mockup.composition: Device frame centered, ~70% viewport. Subtle parallax. Foreground UI in sharp focus, background ambient.
device_mockup.typography: UI text follows product's own type system inside the device.
device_mockup.color: Device chrome muted. Screen content full saturation. Background: page color.
device_mockup.surfaces: Device: realistic shadow under, soft edge highlights.
device_mockup.reference: Apple product cinema frame — the device IS the composition.

split_panel.composition: 50/50 horizontal split. Left: text or context. Right: visual or product moment. 32px gutter.
split_panel.typography: Left side: 15-17px body, weight 400. Right side: per its content type.
split_panel.color: Left side text on page bg. Right side may have its own surface.
split_panel.surfaces: Optional vertical rule at split (6% white) when both sides need separation.
split_panel.reference: Linear feature split — text and visual sharing balance, neither dominating.

stat_callout.composition: Single large numeral centered, supporting label below. Generous space around the figure.
stat_callout.typography: Numeral: 64-96px weight 300 to 500, tabular figures. Label: 13-15px weight 500 at 70% opacity.
stat_callout.color: Numeral: full text color. Label: muted. Optional accent on numeral if it carries trend semantics.
stat_callout.reference: Stripe annual report stat — the number is the design.
